content.popupText: Only 3 pairs left! Enter your card details now before they're gone.

do.text: You used your parent's card. The money was taken, and the sneakers never arrived.

ignore.text: You closed the page and kept your money. But the next 'mega deal' might be harder to spot.

tell.text: Dad looked up the store and found warnings that it's fake. He reported it, and your family's money stayed safe.

buddy.intro: You're looking for new sneakers online, and this pops up!
buddy.explain: These sneakers are almost free! The pop-up wants your card number to buy them.
buddy.choices: You can buy them now, close the page, or tell an adult. What would you do?

do.text: Oh no! Let's see what happened.

ignore.text: You kept your money, but the fake store is still out there.

tell.text: Nice work! A grown-up helped spot the fake store!

stop.text: This countdown was trying to make you buy before you could think.

check.text: 90% off is too good to be true. Real stores almost never have deals this big.
This isn't a store you know, and the web address looks strange.
Never type in a card number without a grown-up.

recap.tell: Show a grown-up and say: 'I found a really cheap deal. Can you check if this store is real?'

tip.label: Shop safely
buddy: Only shop on stores your family knows and trusts.
Always ask a grown-up before you buy anything online.

summary.solution: Only shop on stores your family trusts, and ask a grown-up first.
checks: Deals that are too good to be true
